name: Agile Long-horned Bee
desc: Agile Long-horned Bee (Melissodes agilis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 18 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Melissodes agilis, the agile long-horned bee, is a species of long-horned bee in the family Apidae. It is found in Central America and North America.
